models.verification: bootstrap license record; pinned tree accessible, README web read failed

retrieval.unit: one exact registered manual quote; original text unchanged
retrieval.filter: same resolved model_id AND exact document_version for all three methods, before ranking
retrieval.unresolved_scope: missing requested version: request revision, do not substitute current revision
retrieval.foreign_scope: reject use of another model's evidence for the target model

bm25.tokenization: Unicode word regex, casefold; no new Korean morphological analyzer

retrieval.primary_metric: macro Hit@1 on the 11 questions with supported evidence

formulas.Hit@1: 1 if first ID is in gold, otherwise 0; failures count 0
formulas.Recall@3: distinct gold IDs in first 3 / number of gold IDs; failures count 0
formulas.MRR@3: 1 / first relevant rank when rank <=3, otherwise 0
formulas.model_mix_rate@3: foreign model IDs / returned IDs; empty=NA
formulas.version_mix_rate@3: wrong document version IDs / returned IDs; empty=NA

retrieval.no_gold_policy: 4 non-answerable/scope/input cases excluded from ranking average; response disposition and prohibited claims reviewed separately

latency.order: fixed shuffled query order shared across methods
latency.boundary: warm query embedding + structural filtering/ranking + optional reranking; cold download/load/index separate
latency.failure_policy: record every attempt; timeouts/failures retained, latency summary successful attempts only with failure_count

runtime.initial_device: same host CPU for all methods
runtime.gpu_track: separate run only after assigned GPU usage check; never compare CPU and GPU as same-condition latency

retrieval.truncation_policy: record actual tokenizer lengths; any truncation requires new protocol version and rerun of all methods

changed_input: 21 exact registered manual excerpts, replacing 27 development fact summaries
requested_implementation: same frozen retrieval-v1 CLS/float32 and local CPU settings
runtime_filter: missing revision produces request_revision; no current revision substitution
score_policy: retain legacy ID diagnostics separately; do not claim semantic Hit@1 until FR-01 mapping is resolved
latency_summary: supported-query successful attempts only, nearest-rank p95; retain all no-gold/failed/empty attempt timings separately
zero_score_policy: preserve old BM25 zero-score ranking behavior; record zero_score_only separately from empty list
required_before_new_execution: 13 fixed registration/export/API/original/restart evidence agrees with manifest
PM reviews FR-01 changed quote and gold mapping
all tokenizer lengths including query/excerpt pairs <=256
same approved model-ready isolated environment and CPU reservation available
